{"code": "
import nanosurf
import time
import os

# Load application
spm = nanosurf.SPM()
application = spm.application

# Get scan and operating mode objects
scan = application.Scan
opmode = application.OperatingMode

# Set operating mode to tapping/dynamic mode to minimize tip damage
opmode.OperatingMode = spm.OperatingMode.PhaseContrast  # Tapping mode

# Set scan parameters for 30x30 µm² with 128x128 resolution
scan.ImageWidth = 30e-6  # 30 µm in meters
scan.ImageHeight = 30e-6  # 30 µm in meters
scan.Points = 128  # points per line
scan.Lines = 128  # lines per frame

print(f"Scan parameters set:")
print(f"  Image size: {scan.ImageWidth*1e6} x {scan.ImageHeight*1e6} µm²")
print(f"  Resolution: {scan.Points} x {scan.Lines}")
print(f"  Operating mode: Tapping/Phase Contrast")

# Start the scan
print("\nStarting scan...")
scan.StartFrameUp()

# Wait for scan to complete
scanning = scan.IsScanning
while scanning:
    remaining = scan.Lines - scan.Currentline
    print(f"Scanning in progress... Remaining lines: {remaining}")
    time.sleep(3)
    scanning = scan.IsScanning

print("Scanning finished!")

# Get the file path of the last saved image
# The image is automatically saved by the system
last_file = application.GetLastGalleryFilePath()
print(f"\nImage saved at: {last_file}")

# Get absolute path
abs_path = os.path.abspath(last_file)
print(f"Absolute path: {abs_path}")

del spm
"}
